title: How representative are selected motor routes? A single-specimen connectome robustness audit
status: Exploratory single-specimen secondary analysis; not preregistered or peer reviewed
plan_amendment: Added threshold15 following literature review of Yang Fig7. An independent reviewer supplied primary threshold10 outcomes after the original plan was written and before this amendment and the main run. Threshold15 was literature motivated, not selected for its outcome. All outputs are exploratory. Positive-contra LI is opposite to the ipsi-minus-contra convention in Cheong; outgoing-normalized route mass is complementary to, not a reproduction of, published input-normalized effective connectivity.

reproduction.install: python -m pip install numpy==2.4.3 pandas==2.3.3 pyarrow==23.0.1 matplotlib==3.10.8
reproduction.working_directory: Directory containing the code and this plan; place downloaded files at the relative save_as paths above

robustness.interpretation: This confirms descriptive sign stability within the chosen graph definitions, not a new motor mechanism. Stronger thresholds retain less mass even where the side index approaches an extreme.

primary_definition: Foreleg-annotated T1 motor neurons; all vnc_intrinsic intermediate somata; exact two-edge paths; both edges >=10 synapses

scores.routing_mass: O_i = sum of all released outgoing edge weights of i BEFORE any analysis threshold or filtering. Direct endpoint score=w_dm/O_d. Two-edge score=sum_i (w_di/O_d)*(w_im/O_i) over eligible paths. This dimensionless graph-routing score is not a transmission probability or strength of physiological influence.
scores.side_LI: (contralateral mass-ipsilateral mass)/(contralateral mass+ipsilateral mass), relative to DN somaSide; no known-side mass gives null
scores.binary_reach: Unique reached motor bodyIds per side, never independent path samples
scores.availability_corrected_reach_LI: Compute reached/available motor count for each side, then (contra_fraction-ipsi_fraction)/(contra_fraction+ipsi_fraction); no available side or no reached cells gives null
scores.unknown_sides: Keep unknown-side count/mass explicit and outside known-side LI; publish known-side coverage
scores.concentration: Largest intermediate contribution / total eligible routing mass; deterministic tie break lower intermediate bodyId
scores.deletion_stress: Remove that intermediate without renormalizing source or other outgoing denominators, recalculate side LI. This is graph sensitivity, not simulated biological ablation.
scores.retention: Threshold routing mass divided by threshold-1 mass for the same source, route and endpoint definition

interpretation: Positive LI denotes contralateral annotated motor soma relative to DN soma; it does not denote the side of a muscle or turn. Ranges across analytic settings are sensitivity ranges, not confidence intervals.
limitations: Incomplete reconstruction/annotation are not statistically modeled
No transmitter signs, dynamics, muscles or forces
Somatic restrictions are not neuropil restrictions
Separate optomotor behavior data cannot establish a paired causal chain
Unchanged sign does not validate physiology or behavior

All four DN source records are labeled Prelim Roughly traced. This is an annotation warning, not a quantified reconstruction error rate. Motor rootSide is missing; somaSide cannot by itself verify target-muscle side, synapse location or action direction.
availability: Blank CSV metrics and JSON null mean undefined/no denominator; they are not zero effects.
